tsbs.title: Head gasket can leak coolant (warranty extended)
tsbs.plain_summary: On some 2023-2026 CR-Vs with the 1.5L turbo, the head gasket can stop sealing well. The engine may run hot, lose coolant or misfire. Honda lengthened the warranty on this part. A Honda dealer checks your VIN to see if it qualifies.

coverage.term: 10 years or 150,000 miles, whichever comes first

tsbs.title: Hybrid engine software update for engine temperature
tsbs.plain_summary: Honda is updating engine computer software on some 2023-2026 CR-V Hybrids. The update changes how the electric water pump runs, to help keep engine temperature in check. Honda planned to start telling owners in September 2026. A dealer can check your VIN.
